notes: Customer background: team builds JetBrains (IntelliJ/PyCharm) plugins to deliver AI-assisted completion to enterprise dev teams.
Primary ask: low-latency streaming completions inside editor with local project indexing and model/version pinning per workspace.
Quote: 'We need completions that feel native — streaming char-by-char, <50ms token latency, but data must never leave the customer's control for some accounts.'
POC constraints: local indexer must run on developer machines (8–32GB) and also provide optional on-prem server for CI and shared indexes.
Model requirements: support for quantized models (4-bit) for local inference, and stable pin to v1.2 for reproducible completions. Allow fallback to hosted variants when local capacity insufficient.
Security: SAML SSO for admin console, audit logs for completion queries, retention controls and EU data residency for EU clients.
Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to pay reserved for Dedicated for team seats, but prefer Optimize recommendations to reduce per-token cost where possible.
Integrations: JetBrains Plugin SDK, internal telemetry (segment), CI (GitLab), and optional on-prem embedding store for repo search.
Marketplace: plugin must pass JetBrains security checks; suggested timeline ~3–5 weeks after POC.
